description: A notes app with three real blockers, each reported where the code is: a workspace table without RLS (its CREATE TABLE after leading comments), a Stripe webhook that never verifies the signature (its POST handler), and an unguarded service-role client (the createClient call). The profiles table beside it is secured, with RLS enabled by an ALTER TABLE split across two lines.
origin: Written for the corpus while adding code snippets to blockers. It first reported every one of these defects on line 1, blamed the secured profiles table twice (a missing-RLS blocker for the split ALTER TABLE, and an auth.users link pinned on notes), and hid the real notes defect behind the second.
